title: Contact — Baker Road Baptist Church
metaDescription: Call, write, or visit Baker Road Baptist Church at 900 W. Baker Rd, Baytown, Texas. Office hours, prayer requests, and how to ask about baptism or membership.
headline: Get in touch.
intro: Call or stop by during office hours.

sections.heading: Let us pray for you
sections.body: Tell us as much or as little as you want, and say whether you would like someone to follow up.
sections.note: Requests go to the pastor and the prayer team.

sections.heading: Send us a note
sections.body: Questions about visiting, membership, baptism, weddings, or getting your family plugged in. Call the office and we will help.

sections.heading: Baptism and membership
sections.body: If you have put your faith in Jesus and have never been baptized, we would count it an honor. If Baker Road is becoming your church home, membership is how you say so out loud. Either one starts with a conversation. Call the office and ask for Pastor Marvin.
